name: DRLVaultV3
summary: DRLVault.swapToWETH traded through the USDC/WETH pool with no effective slippage guard, so the attacker sandwiched the vault after manipulating the pool price.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

ageReset.description: Clone basis: the vault clone pins its master and held the USDC inventory sold through the unguarded swap path.

limitations: Target identity and code history were imported from the seed inventory without independent review.

sources.note: Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim is an EIP-1167 minimal-proxy clone whose 45-byte runtime hardcodes the master 0x8aa6b0e10bd6dbaf5159967f92f2e740afe2b4c3 (created at block 23731141), so the DELEGATECALL target cannot be repointed; the master's runtime is byte-identical at the clone's creation block 23767200 and the incident block 23769387 and contains no DELEGATECALL, so the 7.3-hour age is measured from the deployment of code that never changed.

Clone basis retained under the case-by-case rule: the clone held the vault's USDC inventory, making its own deployment the start of the exposure to the shared swap path. Root cause and loss remain provisional.

limitations: Classification and loss were imported from the seed inventory and await review.
The imported USD loss lacks structured valuation provenance.
